decisions.reason: The hyaluronic acid facial serum fits the firm's core natural facial-care range, matches steady demand for simple effective actives, and remains less likely to be cut than more overlapping products.

The facial cleansing milk still suits the firm's gentle-care positioning, but in a small portfolio it faces higher rationalisation risk because cleansing formats can overlap and newer launches may compete for attention.
The facial cleansing oil is a recent launch close to the firm's established offer, so management would usually give it more time on the market unless early performance clearly disappointed.
